statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of four representative MPA templates. Mandatory third-party age verification prevented entry to underlying interactive content, but the gate and server-rendered DOM/network surfaces remained auditable.

page.notes: Adult media catalog with a mandatory AgeGO verification overlay. Home listing, video detail, models index, and privacy/legal template sampled; account, payment, favorites/history, and deeper post-verification playback were not covered because they require verification/authentication and duplicate template families.

paths.description: Homepage/listing and mandatory verification entry; representative navigation and feed template.
Representative video-detail/playback template and primary content journey.
Privacy policy, representing long-form legal/content template.

findings.summary: The site does not respond to the user color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no prefers-color-scheme rules, and the dark-condition screenshot is visually identical to the default gate.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() for page and overlay surfaces.

findings.summary: Text and links fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: axe found 9 serious color-contrast failures; Lighthouse also failed its color-contrast audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG AA and test every gate and footer state.

findings.summary: The full-screen age gate is a custom fixed div rather than a modal dialog.
findings.evidence: DOM evidence shows #agego-overlay-container is a div with no dialog role, aria-modal, or native dialog element.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the gate as a modal <dialog> with an accessible name and deliberate focus management.

findings.summary: Components rely on viewport rules rather than container-aware adaptation.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no @container or container-type declarations across the rendered styles.
findings.suggestedFix: Use container queries for reusable cards, navigation, and the verification panel where component width controls layout.

findings.summary: The mandatory verification flow intermittently renders as an empty panel.
findings.evidence: Video and privacy screenshots show a blank dark verification panel while home/models render controls; the HAR records the AgeGO authorization request aborted.
findings.suggestedFix: Fail closed with locally rendered explanatory copy and retry/exit controls when the verification provider does not initialize.

findings.summary: Loading performance is poor on the primary entry path.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 8.4s, FCP 4.2s, TBT 580ms and performance 44; trace corroborated LCP 3.51s and 189ms TBT under a separate run.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the real LCP, defer non-critical scripts/media, and split long tasks.

findings.summary: Mobile detail and listing templates shift materially after load.
findings.evidence: Layout evidence measured CLS 0.117 on the video page and 0.101 on models.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve stable dimensions for late content, ads, embeds, media, and verification UI.

findings.summary: The entry page loads a large, mostly third-party dependency graph before verification.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 145 requests and 4.52 MB, including parser-blocking verification, ad, language, and multiple main scripts; Lighthouse estimates 2.21s render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate/nonessential scripts, defer parser-blocking code, and delay ads/media until after consent and intent.

findings.summary: A substantial share of JavaScript is unused.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports an estimated 874 KiB of unused JavaScript and 53 KiB legacy-JS savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Use coverage to remove unused bundles, avoid duplicate main.min versions, and conditionally load route features.

findings.summary: Some interactive and embedded content lacks accessible names.
findings.evidence: axe found an unnamed iframe and an unnamed link; the custom age gate also lacks dialog semantics.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every iframe a concise title, every link an accessible name, and expose the gate as a named modal.

findings.summary: Landmark coverage and keyboard access are incomplete.
findings.evidence: axe reports 287 elements outside landmarks and #agego-prompt-about as a non-focusable scrollable region.
findings.suggestedFix: Use header/nav/main/footer landmarks and make the scrollable gate copy keyboard focusable with visible focus.

findings.summary: The viewport declaration restricts browser zoom.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse and axe both fail the viewport rule because maximum-scale=1 is below the required zoom range.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and allow pinch zoom while preserving responsive reflow.

findings.summary: Images have sizing and aspect-ratio defects.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 6 images without dimensions; Lighthouse failed incorrect aspect ratio and unsized-image audits.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio and preserve the source ratio at render time.

findings.summary: A synchronous main-thread XHR uses a deprecated, blocking API.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse pinpoints a synchronous XMLHttpRequest at the home document line 129.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace synchronous XHR with async fetch and render a safe pending/failure state.

findings.summary: Video metadata is incomplete and low quality.
findings.evidence: The representative video page has no h1 and its meta description is only “About ♦”; other templates have meaningful title/description metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate a descriptive H1 and unique, content-specific meta description for every video detail page.

findings.summary: Social metadata is absent on representative templates.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found zero Open Graph tags across home, video, models, and privacy; the video page also has no JSON-LD.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph/Twitter cards and VideoObject structured data matching visible detail content.

findings.summary: Important security headers and cookie protections are missing.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy; all four observed cookies lacked Secure and used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP in report-only then enforce it, add HSTS/nosniff/referrer/permissions policies, and set Secure with the narrowest viable SameSite.

findings.summary: Tracking and advertising execute before age verification completes.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence saw 17 third-party origins including Google Analytics; HAR attributed 138/145 requests and 4.44 MB to third parties while the gate was still active.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not initialize analytics, ad networks, or preview media until lawful consent/verification and user intent; reduce vendors and retention.

findings.summary: Image delivery is not responsive or size-efficient.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 97/100 images without srcset, 9 oversized images, 11 legacy-format images, and 6 without dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive variants with srcset/sizes and correct intrinsic dimensions.

findings.summary: Media and third-party work is loaded behind the blocking age gate.
findings.evidence: HAR transferred 4.52 MB, including 1.56 MB media and 1.44 MB XHR/fetch; 4.44 MB was attributed to third-party origins before access.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a pre-verification budget near zero: load only the gate, then fetch thumbnails/media and advertising after verified intent.

findings.summary: The blocked entry state has a disproportionately large DOM/heap footprint.
findings.evidence: The heap summary reports 250,354 heap nodes, 900,942 edges and 17.48 MB self-size while only an age gate is usable; DOM probe counted 3,047 elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid constructing the underlying feed, players, and ad widgets until verification succeeds; clean up provider listeners and timers.
